text: i want your new name to be joshua
interpretation: Meta-intent repair: the user wants to rename the assistant rather than themselves. DA-SCL selects change_ai_name instead of change_user_name.

text: tell me how much my verizon and comcast bill come to together
interpretation: Cross-domain repair: the request asks for the total amount owed on two bills rather than income. DA-SCL selects bill_balance within banking.
Same-domain repair: slow down is a speed-control request rather than a cancellation. DA-SCL selects change_speed.

text: on the shopping list did i put tomato
interpretation: Same-domain repair: the user asks whether tomato appears on the list rather than requesting an update. DA-SCL selects shopping_list.

text: i would like to know how to perform an oil change
interpretation: Same-domain repair: the user asks for the oil-change procedure rather than its timing. DA-SCL selects oil_change_how.
Small-talk regression: bonjour is a greeting rather than a farewell. DA-SCL incorrectly selects goodbye.

text: what do i have to do on january 1st
interpretation: Same-domain regression: the user asks about calendar information on a date rather than explicitly requesting an update. DA-SCL selects calendar_update.

text: how much is my gas bill
interpretation: Same-domain regression: the user asks for the bill amount rather than its due status or due date. DA-SCL selects bill_due instead of bill_balance.

text: i went to target to buy a mug but my card did not work
interpretation: Same-domain regression: a card that did not work is a decline rather than physical damage. DA-SCL selects damaged_card.
Small-talk regression: good day is a greeting rather than a goodbye. DA-SCL selects the opposite conversational intent.
